selection_rule: Select the four listed eligible candidates in case-slot order. Each selected case must use exactly four unique human-authored PostgreSQL primary sources allocated one per producer, include at least one explicit pre/post semantic conflict, keep all required evidence within the frozen 30-day non-stale window, and expose an exact ordered answer. Selection is based only on source semantics and design validity; treatment/evaluator outcomes are never observed or used, and source-byte reuse with any selected confirmatory case is forbidden.

eligible_candidates.question: Across the pinned PostgreSQL sources around the WITH CHECK OPTION fix, give four values in order: the pre-fix rewriter gate, the post-fix DELETE predicate, whether out-of-view DELETE FOR PORTION OF leftovers are rejected after the fix, and the expected error phrase.
eligible_candidates.canonical_answer: insert_or_update; CMD_DELETE && parsetree->forPortionOf != NULL; rejected; new row violates check option for view
ordered_required_slots: new row violates check option for view
